topic: being the strong one for everyone
lines: He never stops hearing his sister’s nonstop complaints.
She calls at night, sobbing, and he stays awake listening.
Dawn arrives, his own work still waiting untouched.
He convinces himself it’s just being a good brother.
The real reason is fearing people will call him selfish.
Remember, caring for her doesn’t have to ruin your day.
Follow for more daily psychology about people and relationships.

caption: Loving someone doesn’t require sacrificing your own life. Save this if you need to set limits.
